messages.subject: Your Quillstack onsite: Senior Software Engineer
messages.body:
Hi Sam,

We're excited to host you for the onsite loop for the Senior Software Engineer role on Friday, November 20, 2026 at 9:30 AM PT at our San Francisco office.

Schedule:
1. Coding (60 min)
2. System design (60 min)
3. Low-level design / object-oriented design (45 min)
4. Behavioral with the hiring manager (45 min)

See you soon,
Rita Osei, Quillstack Recruiting
